## Bio

I am a data scientist and software developer with a background in bioinformatics
and public audit.

My current role is as an R/R Shiny developer at Audit Scotland. I am part of a
small team that develop web-based applications using tools such as R Shiny,
Python Shiny and Quarto for the analysis of financial and performance audit data
generated from public bodies in Scotland. The overarching theme of this work is
to gain insights into the performance of public bodies across Scotland. This
contributes to Audit Scotland's overall aim to ensure public money is well spent
to meet the needs of the people of Scotland.

In my former roles I functioned as a Senior Bioinformatics Developer and
Bioinformatician at Fios Genomics. Fios Genomics is a contract research
organisation providing bioinformatic data analysis services to a range of
clients in the pharmaceutical and academic sectors. I was part of a small team
that developed R and Python software packages for use by a team of
bioinformaticians to perform a variety of bioinformatic analyses. Typical
projects included differential gene expression analyses, anti-sense
oligonucleotide design, genetic variant identification, and development of
machine learning models using omics data sets.

I have keen interest in R and Python package development and how tools such as
Shiny and Quarto can be used to visualise complex datasets.

This site contains a copy of my CV and a list of some projects that I have
worked on.
